title: Website won't load? Try this one command
caption:
Website won't load but everything else works? Try ipconfig /flushdns 💻

✅ Start > type CMD > right-click Command Prompt > Run as administrator
✅ Type: ipconfig /flushdns and press Enter
✅ You should see: Successfully flushed the DNS Resolver Cache
✅ Reload the website
It only clears Windows' saved list of website addresses, and Windows rebuilds it as you browse.
